newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales very slow at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales very slow at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test few sales steady, USDA said.

Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 76300 head confirmed including 21900 head or about 29 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 63.00, pen lower dressing 62.50. Confirmed - 700
